title: My Food and Drinks
text:
I like food very much. In the morning, I eat bread with butter and I drink a cup of coffee. My favorite food is rice with beans. It is cheap and good.

At lunch, I eat at home with my family. We eat chicken, rice and salad. After lunch, I drink a glass of water. In the evening, I like to drink orange juice.

questions.text: What does the writer eat with butter in the morning?
Who does the writer eat lunch with?
What is the writer's feeling about food?
How does the writer probably feel about meals with the family?

vocabulary.definition: a food made from flour and water, baked in an oven
a soft yellow food made from milk, eaten on bread
the people you live with, such as parents and children

paragraph_translations: Eu gosto muito de comida. De manhã, eu como pão com manteiga e tomo uma xícara de café. Minha comida favorita é arroz com feijão. Ela é barata e boa.
No almoço, eu como em casa com minha família. Nós comemos frango, arroz e salada. Depois do almoço, eu bebo um copo de água. À noite, eu gosto de beber suco de laranja.
